sources.title: Shepherd et al. JCO 2000; TAX317 primary trial
sources.facts_used: Dose-specific 75 mg/m² median OS 7.5 vs 4.6 months; P=.010; historical post-platinum NSCLC. No 100 mg/m² result transferred.
sources.access: Publisher abstract in search retrieval; PubMed bibliographic confirmation. Full publisher open returned 403; no full-text-only claim.

sources.title: Fossella et al. JCO 2000
sources.facts_used: 373 randomised; overall survival not statistically different among groups. Used as context limitation, not an additional survival-gain claim.

sources.title: Phase II study of weekly paclitaxel for relapsed and refractory SCLC
sources.facts_used: 22 enrolled,21 eligible; five PR (3/11 sensitive,2/10 refractory);80 mg/m² weekly for six of eight weeks; grade3/4 neutropenia64%. Schedule differs from NCCP and no comparator.
